status: Source characterization retained; replacement implemented and focused-tested. Actual app and full-core acceptance remain pending; see writing-statistics.json.

legacyContract.input: The committed preview DOM, not Markdown source. Manual-render mode retains last published counts until Render; show-counter enables background rendering even when preview pane is hidden in automatic mode.
modes: Characters excluding whitespace and newline characters
legacyContract.words: Foundation NSStringEnumerationByWords per DOM text/CDATA node. SCRIPT,STYLE,HEAD subtrees excluded. PRE>CODE blocks excluded from words only; inline CODE is one word only if its children contain at least one Foundation word. Other child nodes accumulate independently.
legacyContract.characters: UTF16 NSString lengths after removing Foundation newline characters; code blocks remain included. No grapheme count substitution without an explicit compatibility decision.
legacyContract.charactersWithoutSpaces: UTF16 NSString lengths after removing Foundation whitespaceAndNewline characters; code blocks remain included.
legacyContract.ui: Optional per-document popup; mode is editorWordCountType. Visibility is editorShowWordCount. Counter enabled only once preview is ready.
legacyContract.sourceSafety: Statistics must never mutate source, native selection, Undo or file bytes.

modernImplementationGates: Migrate original visibility/mode preferences without changing unrelated live settings.
Characterize visible rendered text including styled-node boundaries, inline/block code, Unicode/emoji/combining marks, newline/space classes, raw HTML, math/diagrams and footnotes.
Keep counts aligned with the published rendering revision, including manual-render stale cache semantics and source-only mode.
Count outside typing/layout critical paths; no repeated whole-document/main-thread recount per keystroke, unbounded DOM polling or remote service.
Native accessible optional counter with all three modes, focus-based document ownership, keyboard operation and unchanged source/Undo.
Actual UI/manual-render/edit/Undo/persistence acceptance before retiring old counter code.
notAccepted: No full counter parity or legacy retirement claim before actual-app and full-core verification.
